column1: # Dutch guidance reference doses (ED05) - NVWA, cross-contact of allergens, April 2024
# Action Limit (ppm) = rfdMg / consumption amount (kg), capped by maxActionPpm when set.
# Gluten-containing cereals are capped at 20 ppm to stay consistent with the legal
# gluten-free threshold, whatever the consumption amount.
# allergenCode must match bcpg:allergenCode on the allergen characteristic.
# proteinPerc is optional: leave it empty when the declared quantity is already
# expressed in allergenic protein. Complete this grid with the allergens you use:
# an allergen absent from the grid keeps the fixed threshold it carries.
